implementation.candidate_authority: The inert report compiler exposes an opaque, digest-bound GovernedCandidate only for the exact runtime-policy proposal, baseline/finding/scenario bindings, run profile, qualified native Codex posture, fail-closed behavior, and three exact governed repetitions. The governed package public Start entrypoint accepts that Proposal and no arbitrary policy bytes.
implementation.candidate_load: The gateway loads the fixed recordingTool policy through authenticated Backend POST /agent/:agentId/policies, requires the exact 201 response and current/active policy fields, then polls the exact OPA data path until that same candidate reason returns block.
implementation.gateway: A random literal-loopback listener accepts only the qualified SDK auth and evaluate routes, exact Host and RequestURI, the run agent bearer, bounded bodies, closed headers, and no query aliases. It forwards to the exact loopback Core with proxy and redirects disabled and records bounded body-free digests and the real Core decision.
implementation.lifecycle: Candidate-load or listener failure invokes the mandatory run-owned cleanup. Session Close shuts down the gateway and erases the complete isolated Compose project once; candidate deactivation alone is never considered cleanup.
implementation.verdict_boundary: The gateway contains no ALLOW or BLOCK response body. The retained BLOCK was parsed from the real Core response and matched the policy ID created by the Backend and activated through OPA.
